provenance: Manual transcription of local HTTP timing and response observations; not a model-accuracy or production-throughput benchmark.
hardware: two physical Blackhole P150a; Flash opened PCIe ID 0 (1x1), Clef opened IDs 0 and 1 (1x2); both services stopped afterward

runtime.build: nix build .#qwen38 --no-link --print-out-paths --option substituters '' --option builders '' succeeded, including the package device-free installCheck

change: For Clef-Flash hidden-state prefill only, pad each <=1024-token segment to the next 128-token GDN subchunk, rather than the next 128/256/512/1024 masked bucket. The two-device Clef branch retains its old bucket selection.
method: One serial localhost POST /v1/systemone at a time, urllib.request + time.perf_counter through parsed JSON. Baseline versus candidate alternated within one process after warming each shape, with a temporary in-memory bucket selector and otherwise identical model/runtime; candidate is the exact Flash policy subsequently packaged. The 8 measurements per arm exclude first-use compilation. Production-wrapper samples used the rebuilt package without the selector or profiler. No TTsim claim.

request.state: 'filler ' repeated N times, followed by 'The final code is 42.'

question.instructions: Which code appears at the end?

two_device_candidate_not_retained.note: Temporary 128-row bucket experiment under variable host load, not a package change; results did not show an improvement and first-use compilation added cost.

cold_shape_limit: New bucket sizes compile on their first use. In the rebuilt Flash wrapper, first HTTP requests for 342/602/742/892/1342 tokens took 52.2174/16.208/16.2172/15.9123/18.3653 seconds respectively; the first 342-token request also compiled the new package's previously unwarmed kernels. These are observed first-request times, not an isolated estimate of incremental compilation cost. Startup is not prewarmed; measure warm latency only after each required shape has compiled.
scope: Bounded single-chip text, image, video, state-reset and >1024-token recurrence checks plus two-chip text recheck. Exact recorded decisions matched the old path on the paired examples; no model-wide numerical equivalence, cold-latency improvement, 16384-token capacity, stable fleet-wide speedup or production admission is established.
